mapper.select: select r.id as candidateId, r.member_id as merchantId, r.topic_id as topicId, r.node_id as nodeId, r.address_name as addressName, r.address as address, r.longitude as longitude, r.latitude as latitude, r.pic_url as picUrl, r.start_date as startDate, r.end_date as endDate, r.limit_num as limitNum, r.coupon_id as couponId, r.mode as mode, m.name as merchantName, m.category_id as categoryId, m.business_time as businessTime, m.capacity as capacity, m.suit_activity_types as suitActivityTypes, m.coop_open as coopOpen, c.name as couponName, c.amount as couponAmount, (ifnull(c.publish_count, 0) - ifnull(c.receive_count, 0)) as couponStock, ifnull(cr.rating, 0) as rating, (6371000 * acos(least(1, cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(cast(r.latitude as decimal(12,7)))) * cos(radians(cast(r.longitude as decimal(12,7))) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(cast(r.latitude as decimal(12,7)))) ))) as distance from cms_registration_merchant r left join mms_merchant m on m.member_id = r.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 left join sms_coupon c on c.id = r.coupon_id and c.del_flag = 0 left join ( select to_id, round(avg(rating), 2) as rating from coop_review where del_flag = 0 group by to_id ) cr on cr.to_id = r.member_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.longitude is not null and r.longitude <> '' and r.latitude is not null and r.latitude <> '' and r.status = 1 and r.audit_status = 1 and m.id is not null and m.status = 1 and m.account_status = 1 and (c.id is null or (c.status = 1 and (ifnull(c.publish_count, 0) - ifnull(c.receive_count, 0)) > 0)) having distance <= #{radius} order by distance asc limit #{limit}
